title: Design System: BELIVIN MEDIA — Signal Cut

display-hero.purpose: The first-viewport outcome and opposing consequence line.

display-section.purpose: Short, dominant problem, solution, proof, and conversion statements.

display-title.purpose: Service, reason, process, and testimonial subheads.

body.purpose: Plain-language customer outcomes and service explanation.

navigation.purpose: Compact desktop and mobile navigation labels.

action.purpose: Website-Check controls and other decisive interaction labels.

brand.purpose: Tracked BELIVIN MEDIA identity in header and footer.

shadows.name: action-default
shadows.purpose: Compact depth beneath the mint primary action.

shadows.name: action-hover
shadows.purpose: The only lifted hover depth in the system.

shadows.name: action-dark
shadows.purpose: Quieter depth for the dark action on the mint closing field.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Decisive easing for brief lifts, underlines, menu movement, and the hero entrance.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Background and compact control state changes.

motion.name: state-standard
motion.purpose: Button lift and navigation underline response.

motion.name: hero-copy-reveal
motion.purpose: One-time opacity and rise reveal for hero copy when reduced motion is not requested; text is never used as a clipping plane.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Forces content visible and effectively removes animation and transition when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary Website-Check Action
components.description: The repeated high-salience action that links directly to the approved Calendly destination.
components.css: .ds-primary-action { min-height: 54px; width: fit-content; max-width: 100%; padding: 15px 22px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: var(--mint, #5ce1c6); color: var(--ink, #0d1024); font-family: var(--body, Manrope, sans-serif); font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; text-align: center; text-decoration: none; white-space: normal; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 0 16px 44px rgba(13, 16, 36, 0.28); transition: background-color 200ms ease, box-shadow 220ms ease, transform 220ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-primary-action:hover { background: var(--mint-active, #70ead1); box-shadow: 0 21px 56px rgba(13, 16, 36, 0.36); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-primary-action:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.985); } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--paper, #f4f6f5); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Dark Closing Action
components.description: The dark inverse of the primary action, reserved for the mint closing field.
components.css: .ds-primary-action-dark { min-height: 54px; width: fit-content; max-width: 100%; padding: 15px 22px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: var(--ink, #0d1024); color: var(--paper, #f4f6f5); font-family: var(--body, Manrope, sans-serif); font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; text-align: center; text-decoration: none; white-space: normal; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 0 16px 44px rgba(13, 16, 36, 0.2); transition: background-color 200ms ease, box-shadow 220ms ease, transform 220ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-primary-action-dark:hover { background: var(--navy-deep, #11113e); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-primary-action-dark:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.985); } .ds-primary-action-dark:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #0d1024); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Header Navigation Action
components.description: A compact mint conversion control for the sticky header and mobile menu.
components.css: .ds-nav-action { min-height: 44px; padding: 11px 15px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: var(--mint, #5ce1c6); color: var(--ink, #0d1024); font-family: var(--body, Manrope, sans-serif); font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 0; transition: background-color 180ms ease, transform 180ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-nav-action:hover { background: var(--mint-active, #70ead1); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-nav-action:active { transform: scale(0.985); } .ds-nav-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--paper, #f4f6f5); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Mobile Menu Toggle
components.description: The square-corner 44px menu control used below the navigation breakpoint.
components.css: .ds-menu-toggle { min-width: 72px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, rgba(244, 246, 245, 0.42)); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--paper, #f4f6f5); font-family: var(--body, Manrope, sans-serif); font-weight: 720; cursor: pointer; } .ds-menu-toggle:hover { border-color: var(--mint, #5ce1c6); } .ds-menu-toggle:active { transform: scale(0.985); } .ds-menu-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--mint, #5ce1c6); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Decision Result
components.description: The mint directional plane that names the final lost-call consequence.
components.css: .ds-decision-result { width: 100%; min-width: 0; padding: 16px 58px 16px 26px; background: var(--mint, #5ce1c6); color: var(--ink, #0d1024); clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 28px) 0, 100% 50%, calc(100% - 28px) 100%, 0 100%); font-family: var(--display, Archivo, Arial Narrow, sans-serif); font-size: clamp(2rem, 3vw, 3rem); font-variation-settings: "wdth" 66, "wght" 720; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 0.96; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

components.name: Main Offer Plane
components.description: The dominant off-white service plane with a mint cut and ruled deliverable list.
components.html:
Eine Website, die ihren Job macht.

Kunden sehen sofort, was Sie anbieten, warum sie bei Ihnen richtig sind und wie sie Sie erreichen.

  • Klare Texte
  • Starker Auftritt
  • Einfacher Kontakt
  • Sauber auf dem Handy
components.css: .ds-offer-main { position: relative; overflow: hidden; min-height: 480px; padding: clamp(42px, 5vw, 74px); display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; gap: 48px; background: var(--paper, #f4f6f5); color: var(--ink, #0d1024); border-radius: 0; } .ds-offer-main::after { content: ""; position: absolute; right: -8%; bottom: -13%; width: 45%; height: 36%; background: var(--mint, #5ce1c6); clip-path: polygon(18% 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-offer-main h3 { position: relative; z-index: 1; max-width: 13ch; margin: 0 0 14px; color: var(--ink, #0d1024); font-family: var(--display, Archivo, Arial Narrow, sans-serif); font-size: clamp(3.4rem, 5.4vw, 5.95rem); font-variation-settings: "wdth" 66, "wght" 760; letter-spacing: -0.026em; line-height: 0.98; } .ds-offer-main p { position: relative; z-index: 1; max-width: 49ch; margin: 0; color: var(--ink, #0d1024); font-family: var(--body, Manrope, sans-serif); line-height: 1.55; } .ds-offer-main ul { position: relative; z-index: 1; width: min(76%, 560px); margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; list-style: none; border-top: 1px solid rgba(13, 16, 36, 0.3); } .ds-offer-main li { padding: 16px 16px 16px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(13, 16, 36, 0.3); color: var(--navy, #212162); font-family: var(--body, Manrope, sans-serif); font-weight: 760; } .ds-offer-main li:nth-child(even) { padding-left: 20px; border-left: 1px solid rgba(13, 16, 36, 0.3); }

components.name: Process Strip
components.description: A mint structural slab that makes the four-step working relationship immediately scannable.
components.html:
Sie müssen kein Web-Projekt leiten.

  1. PrüfenWas bremst?
  2. KlarziehenWas muss die Seite sagen?
  3. BauenWir schreiben, gestalten und setzen um.
  4. WeiterführenWir bleiben an Ihrer Seite.
components.css: .ds-process-strip { position: relative; padding: clamp(34px, 3.8vw, 50px); background: var(--mint, #5ce1c6); color: var(--ink, #0d1024); border-radius: 0; } .ds-process-strip::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: -28px; right: 0; width: 42%; height: 28px; background: var(--mint, #5ce1c6); clip-path: polygon(8% 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-process-strip h3 { max-width: 15ch; margin: 0 0 28px; color: var(--ink, #0d1024); font-family: var(--display, Archivo, Arial Narrow, sans-serif); font-size: clamp(2.9rem, 4.6vw, 5rem); font-variation-settings: "wdth" 66, "wght" 760; letter-spacing: -0.026em; line-height: 0.98; } .ds-process-strip ol { margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); list-style: none; border-top: 1px solid rgba(13, 16, 36, 0.42); } .ds-process-strip li { min-height: 112px; padding: 20px 20px 0 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-process-strip li + li { padding-left: 20px; border-left: 1px solid rgba(13, 16, 36, 0.42); } .ds-process-strip strong { font-family: var(--display, Archivo, Arial Narrow, sans-serif); font-size: 1.65rem; font-variation-settings: "wdth" 68, "wght" 760; } .ds-process-strip span { color: rgba(13, 16, 36, 0.78); font-family: var(--body, Manrope, sans-serif); font-size: 0.92rem; }

narrative.overview:
Signal Cut is a self-confident persuasion system for a website-led agency: deep navy establishes authority, hard off-white planes create forward movement, and a single mint signal marks the path to action. Its visual language is attention-grabbing because the hierarchy is decisive, not because the surface is busy.

The system translates the commercial story into six compact beats: outcome, lost opportunity, solution, working relationship, real proof, and final Website-Check action. Large asymmetric planes, condensed headlines, one real testimonial portrait, and authored cut-paper imagery make a few moments dominant while the Manrope body copy stays plain and credible.

The approved world refuses generic light agency card grids, SaaS gradients, glass, rounded controls, decorative metrics, and continuous motion. All content remains visible without animation, and real proof is visually distinct from atmospheric imagery.
keyCharacteristics: Deep BELIVIN navy is the continuous ground; off-white and mint appear as decisive cuts rather than decorative layers.
Archivo is narrow, heavy, and tightly led for display; Manrope carries all explanatory and action text.
Composition uses large asymmetric planes, diagonal masks, structural rules, and full-width consequence lines.
The primary Website-Check action is always a direct Calendly link and the only repeated high-salience control.
The abstract open doorway and mint path are atmospheric metaphors for new business entering; Cristina Hubrath's named portrait and quote are the sole customer proof.
Motion is limited to one brief hero-copy reveal and short control responses, with a complete reduced-motion fallback.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Mint marks action, consequence, or the successful path; it never becomes a general decorative fill across several competing elements.

rules.name: The Navy Field Rule
rules.body: The page remains visibly navy-led even where paper or mint planes take over a section.

rules.name: The Condensed Consequence Rule
rules.body: Use the narrow display axis for outcomes and consequences; never use it for long paragraphs.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Archivo carries identity and hierarchy; Manrope carries explanation and action. Do not introduce a third typographic voice.

rules.name: The Few Dominant Moments Rule
rules.body: Each section gets one commanding plane or statement; do not subdivide the story into equal card tiles.

rules.name: The Mobile Recomposition Rule
rules.body: Mobile starts at 320px with copy and complete intrinsic art in normal flow; short landscape uses a contained 62/38 split, and desktop complexity is added only when width and aspect ratio allow it.

rules.name: The Structural Depth Rule
rules.body: Planes, cuts, and photography create depth; do not add ambient card shadows or glass layers.

rules.name: The Hard Cut Rule
rules.body: Keep buttons, menus, offer planes, and process fields rectangular; use diagonals only where they express movement or consequence.

rules.name: The Direct Action Rule
rules.body: Every Website-Check component links straight to the approved Calendly destination; never insert an on-page intermediate step.

dos: Do keep the six-section outcome → loss → solution → collaboration → proof → action story compact and customer-centered.
Do reserve mint for the next action, the decisive consequence, or the successful path.
Do preserve the abstract open doorway and single mint path as atmospheric art, and the named Cristina portrait and quote as real proof.
Do use large asymmetric planes, clipped diagonals, and structural rules to establish hierarchy.
Do keep all content visible without animation and preserve the reduced-motion and reduced-transparency fallbacks.
Do run the automated portrait, short-landscape, tablet, desktop, large-desktop, reduced-motion, and breakpoint-flank matrix before every release.
donts: Don't add light agency card grids, gradients, glass, rounded pills, decorative metrics, or interchangeable split heroes.
Don't turn mint into a broad decorative palette or introduce colors outside the documented navy, mint, paper, steel, and ink family.
Don't add continuous motion, smooth scrolling, or scroll-dependent content visibility.
Don't use the unused `hero-focus-desktop.webp` or `hero-focus-mobile.webp` assets as Signal Cut visual authority.
Don't invent customer logos, rankings, reviews, statistics, awards, or outcomes.
Don't publish internal positioning, PAS, WIIFM, or Value Equation labels.
